The '''Achillea Great Market''' was located in [[Cadriell]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Achillea]]. It was the largest market in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], and sold all manner of legal merchandise including rare [[Spice/Legends|spices]] and [[Liquor/Legends|liquors]], [[Computer/Legends|computers]], and alien cuisine. It was busy every [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Tapani calendar]], except holidays.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Achillea Great Market was first mentioned in the ''Sector Guide'' for ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a roleplaying supplement for use in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. ''Lords of the Expanse'' was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]],<ref name="LotE" /> and released on [[August 28]], [[1997]].<ref name="Release date">{{BN|url=w/star-wars-the-roleplaying-game-set-box/1018175982|text=Star Wars the Roleplaying Game: Lords of the Expanse}}</ref>
